properties.description: BANK end-to-end: API + Azure SQL + on-prem SQL -> Bronze (ADF) -> Silver (Databricks MERGE) -> Gold, with failure alert.

parameters.message: Banking pipeline failed. Check ADF Monitor and ctl.vw_latest_runs / ops.recon_log.

properties.description: Reads ops/config/ecom_tables.json and ingests every table in parallel. Set backdate='2026-09-01' to reload history.
REST API -> Bronze. Pagination rule on the skip query parameter; nested products[] array flattened via collectionReference.
CDC ingestion for one table; watermark stored in ops/cdc/ecom/<table>.json; supports back-dated refresh.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @concat('SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(23), MAX(', pipeline().parameters.watermark_column, '), 121) AS max_ts, COUNT_BIG(1) AS delta_rows FROM ecom.', pipeline().parameters.table_name, ' WHERE ', pipeline().parameters.watermark_column, ' > ''', variables('v_effective_from'), '''')

@concat('SELECT * FROM ecom.', pipeline().parameters.table_name, ' WHERE ', pipeline().parameters.watermark_column, ' > ''', variables('v_effective_from'), ''' AND ', pipeline().parameters.watermark_column, ' <= ''', activity('lkp_max_cdc').output.firstRow.max_ts, '''')

properties.description: E-COMMERCE end-to-end: API + SQL CDC -> Bronze -> Silver (generic notebook per entity) -> Gold SCD1/SCD2 dims + facts.
CHILD: incremental REST ingestion - meta call for the new watermark, then paged copy (AbsoluteUrl pagination) of the window.
CHILD: watermark-incremental (or full) copy of one Azure SQL table to Bronze parquet, with audit log + failure handling.

sqlReaderQuery.value: @if(equals(pipeline().parameters.load_type, 'FULL'), concat('SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(23), SYSUTCDATETIME(), 121) AS new_watermark, COUNT_BIG(1) AS delta_rows FROM ', concat(pipeline().parameters.source_schema, '.', pipeline().parameters.source_table)), concat('SELECT CONVERT(VARCHAR(23), MAX(', pipeline().parameters.watermark_column, '), 121) AS new_watermark, COUNT_BIG(1) AS delta_rows FROM ', concat(pipeline().parameters.source_schema, '.', pipeline().parameters.source_table), ' WHERE ', pipeline().parameters.watermark_column, ' > ''', pipeline().parameters.last_watermark, ''''))

@if(equals(pipeline().parameters.load_type, 'FULL'), concat('SELECT * FROM ', concat(pipeline().parameters.source_schema, '.', pipeline().parameters.source_table)), concat('SELECT * FROM ', concat(pipeline().parameters.source_schema, '.', pipeline().parameters.source_table), ' WHERE ', pipeline().parameters.watermark_column, ' > ''', pipeline().parameters.last_watermark, ''' AND ', pipeline().parameters.watermark_column, ' <= ''', activity('lkp_new_watermark').output.firstRow.new_watermark, ''''))

properties.description: METADATA-DRIVEN MASTER: reads ctl.ingestion_config and routes every table to the right child pipeline (Azure SQL / on-prem SQL via SHIR / REST API).
